description: Search places to stay in a Polish town or region on noclegi.pl — hotels, guest houses, pensions, apartments, cottages, private rooms, agritourism — with the price for the whole stay, board, guest rating, location and link. Filter by property type, board, minimum rating, free cancellation and total price; sort by price, rating or discount. One results page is up to 50 offers; pass a listing's `slug` to noclegi_object for rooms, rate plans, amenities and the description. Fetched live from noclegi.pl (typically ~1 s via direct fetch; up to ~20 s when it falls back to an unblocker). WITH checkin + checkout, each `price` is the total for the whole stay for the given guests in PLN, incl. taxes and fees (e.g. price_for '2 osoby, 2 noce'); sold-out offers stay listed with price null and available false. WITHOUT dates, `price` is only the site's indicative price for 1 night (price_for '2 osoby, 1 noc'), many offers have none, and the result carries a `note` saying so — pass dates to quote a stay. Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_url, place: { name, slug, kind, area }, heading, stay: { checkin, checkout, nights } | null, guests: { adults, children_ages }, total_count, page, total_pages, count, listings: [...], note? } — the list key is `listings`; `total_count` counts offers across all pages (use `page` for more). Each listing: { id, slug, url, name, type, stars, city, price, price_before_discount, discount_percent, currency, price_for, board, available, free_cancellation, rating, rating_count, rating_label, lat, lng, image, amenities, labels }. `board` is room_only | breakfast | half_board | full_board | …; `rating` is 0–10; `free_cancellation` is the site's deadline text (Polish) or null; `url` opens the property with the same stay. When a place has few offers the site widens to a radius (the note says so; check `city`). An empty match answers count: 0 with a `note` saying why and what to change — that is a successful result, not an error.

board.description: Only offers with this board: room_only, breakfast, half_board, full_board, soft_all_inclusive, all_inclusive.

checkin.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD (from today to about a year ahead). Pass together with checkout; omit both for undated results.

checkout.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD, after checkin — at most 30 nights (the site drops longer stays).

children_ages.description: Each child's age in years (0–17), e.g. [4, 9] for two children — prices depend on ages. Default none.

free_cancellation.description: Only offers that can be cancelled free of charge.

min_rating.description: Only guest ratings of at least 8, 9 or 9.5 (0–10 scale).

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

page.description: Results page, 1-based (up to 50 offers per page). Default 1.

place.description: Town or region in Poland, Polish name preferred: 'Zakopane', 'Szklarska Poręba', 'Białka Tatrzańska', 'Mazury', 'Tatry', 'Polskie morze', 'Bieszczady'. Resolved through noclegi.pl's own place search (diacritics optional; a few English names such as 'Warsaw' or 'Baltic coast' are mapped). A https://noclegi.pl/<place> link also works.

price_max.description: Maximum total price for the whole stay, whole PLN (needs checkin/checkout).

price_min.description: Minimum total price for the whole stay, whole PLN (needs checkin/checkout).

sort.description: Order: recommended (default — the site's own ranking, which may depend on commission), rating, price_asc / price_desc (by price per person per night), discount.

types.description: Only these property types (any of them): hotel, apartment, guest_house (dom gościnny), pension (pensjonat), villa (willa), private_room (kwatera prywatna), wooden_cottage (domek drewniany), year_round_cottage (domek całoroczny), resort (ośrodek wypoczynkowy), agritourism, inn (zajazd), hostel, student_house, sanatorium.

name: noclegi_search
title: Search accommodation in Poland (noclegi.pl)
